title: 第五章 杀凶兽第六章 再遇凶兽
content_zh:
“终于碰到凶兽了，快围起来不要让他跑了”
树林中柳辰正指挥着一个中队的士兵将一只家狗大小的兔子围在中间。
这已经是柳辰来到长林镇巡逻的第七天了，前面六天不要说凶兽了，就是野兽也只有兔子这种小型动物。
柳辰连动手的兴趣都没有。
这使他一度以为自己选择这个地方历练是不是一个错误。
还好今天的运气不错，虽然是只兔子，但这次可是凶兽“迅，身体经过灵气洗礼已经长到家狗大小。
而且因为是风属性凶兽，虽然还不会法术神通，但是速度远超寻常凶兽，爪子跟牙齿也是锋利无比。
“嗖”
“啊...”
“快拦住它，它要跑了”
柳辰还没来得及动手，迅兔就先一步窜了出去。
抓伤了它面前的两个士兵，场上立马就混乱了起来。
还好有普通士兵的阻拦，再加上林虎距离比较近，及时拦下了打算跑出包围圈的迅兔。
柳辰跟巡逻中队的中队长急忙来到迅兔的身后，配合林虎将迅兔成品字形包围在里面。
柳辰这才松了一口气，近处有三名武徒，远处有一个中队的士兵，这次迅兔是插翅难逃了。
“一会我跟林虎主攻，你注意防守，迅兔从你那里逃跑时挡它一下就行”
柳辰对旁边的中队长李三吩咐了一句就没在管他。
“是，少爷”
李三没有托大，直接摆出了防守的姿态。
李三也是个武者，不过他只有入门级武徒的境界，属于刚刚引气入体，只能增加一些力量。

还无法直接把真气运用到战斗中。
至于他的功法则是军队传授的，这也是大部分普通人想要踏入武者行列的选择。
那就是参军，只要混到中队长一级，军队就会免费传授功法，还有专人负责指导引气入体。
传授的虽然不是柳家家传沐阳决，但也够修炼到高级武徒境界了。
其实这已经足够了，没有特殊奇遇的他们，只靠自己水磨功夫式的修炼终其一生也就能突破到低级武徒境界罢了。
由此也可以看出武道修炼对于普通人来说有多么的艰难。
柳辰作为低级武徒，已经可以初步把真气附着在武器上来增加攻击力。
特别是柳辰使用的还是法器，相辅相成之下威力更甚一筹。
而高级武者则也可以实现真气外放，柳辰就见过他父亲柳镇南一刀挥出伴随有丈许长的刀芒，威力恐怖。
“吱吱…”
此时的迅兔冲挡住它去路的柳辰三人发出吱吱的叫声，以此来表达它的不满，此时它的爪子上沾染着鲜血，那是刚刚被它咬伤士兵的血液。
经过灵气洗礼进化成凶兽的它，已经从一只食草的野兔变成了食肉的凶兽迅兔。
面对三人的围困，迅兔直接对着它正面的林虎发起了攻击。
迅兔并没太大的攻击力，从它扑向林虎的那一刻起它的结局就已经注定了。
content_en:
"Finally we encountered a ferocious beast, quickly surround us and don't let him escape."
In the woods, Liu Chen was commanding a squadron of soldiers to surround a rabbit the size of a domestic dog.
This is already the seventh day Liu Chen has been patrolling in Changlin Town. Not to mention ferocious beasts in the previous six days, the only wild beasts are small animals like rabbits.
Liu Chen was not even interested in taking action.
This made him wonder if he had made a mistake in choosing this place to practice.
Fortunately, I had good luck today. Although it was a rabbit, this time it was a ferocious beast. Its body had been baptized by spiritual energy and had grown to the size of a domestic dog.
And because it is a wind attribute beast, although it does not have magical powers, its speed is far faster than ordinary beasts, and its claws and teeth are also extremely sharp.
"Whoosh"
"Ah..."
"Stop it quickly, it's about to run away."
Before Liu Chen could take action, Xuntu rushed out first.
After scratching the two soldiers in front of it, chaos immediately broke out on the field.
Fortunately, there were ordinary soldiers blocking him, and Lin Hu was relatively close, so he stopped Xuntu in time as he was about to run out of the encirclement.
Liu Chen and the squadron leader of the patrol squadron hurriedly came behind Xun Rabbit and cooperated with Lin Hu to surround Xun Rabbit's finished glyph inside.
Liu Chen breathed a sigh of relief. There were three warriors nearby and a squadron of soldiers in the distance. This time, the Swift Rabbit could not escape.
"Lin Hu and I will attack in a while. You should pay attention to defense. Just block the Xuntu when it runs away from you."
Liu Chen gave instructions to the squadron leader Li San next to him and ignored him.
"Yes, Master"
Li San didn't make any excuses and directly assumed a defensive posture.
Li San is also a warrior, but he is only in the realm of an entry-level warrior. He has just introduced Qi into his body and can only increase some strength.
It is not possible to directly use Qi in combat.
As for his skills being taught by the military, this is also the choice for most ordinary people who want to step into the ranks of warriors.
That is to join the army. As long as you reach the level of squadron leader, the army will teach you the exercises for free, and there will be a dedicated person responsible for guiding the introduction of Qi into the body.
Although what he was taught was not the Muyang Jue passed down from the Liu family, it was enough to reach the advanced martial arts level.
In fact, this is enough. Without special adventures, they can break through to the low-level martial arts realm by just relying on their own hard-working Kung Fu training throughout their lives.
This also shows how difficult martial arts training is for ordinary people.
As a low-level martial arts disciple, Liu Chen could already initially attach Qi to weapons to increase attack power.
In particular, Liu Chen used a magical weapon, which was even more powerful when they complemented each other.
High-level warriors can also realize the release of true energy. Liu Chen has seen his father Liu Zhennan swing a sword with a sword that is about ten feet long, and the power is terrifying.
"Zhizhi..."
At this time, the Swift Rabbit squeaked at Liu Chen and the other three who were blocking its path to express its dissatisfaction. At this time, its claws were stained with blood, which was the blood of the soldier it had just bitten.
After being baptized by spiritual energy and evolving into a ferocious beast, it has transformed from a herbivorous hare into a carnivorous ferocious beast, the Swift Rabbit.
Faced with the siege of three people, Xuntu directly attacked Lin Hu in front of it.
The Swift Rabbit did not have much offensive power, and its fate was already doomed from the moment it pounced on Lin Hu.
